scripts.build: pnpm run build:ts && pnpm run build:rust
scripts.lint: pnpm run lint:ts && pnpm run lint:rust && pnpm run lint:py
scripts.lint:py: uv run --frozen ruff check . && uv run --frozen ruff format --check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && cargo fmt --all && uv run --frozen ruff format .
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && uv run --frozen mypy
scripts.test: pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm run test:ts && pnpm run test:rust && pnpm run test:py
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run contracts:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
